name: Kubernetes Context Check
description: Verifies the correct Kubernetes context is active before kubectl commands to prevent accidentally running commands against the wrong cluster
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Verify Kubernetes context before kubectl commands
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
BLOCKED_CONTEXTS=${CLAUDE_K8S_BLOCKED_CONTEXTS:-"production|prod-cluster"}
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '(kubectl|helm)\s'; then
  CURRENT_CTX=$(kubectl config current-context 2>/dev/null)
  if [[ -z "$CURRENT_CTX" ]]; then
    echo "WARNING: No Kubernetes context is set. Run 'kubectl config use-context <name>' first."
    exit 2
  fi
  # Block production contexts for destructive commands
  if echo "$CURRENT_CTX" | grep -qiE "$BLOCKED_CONTEXTS"; then
    if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qiE '(delete|scale|drain|cordon|apply|rollout)'; then
      echo "BLOCKED: Destructive kubectl command against production context '$CURRENT_CTX'."
      echo "Switch to a staging context first."
      exit 2
    fi
    echo "WARNING: Running against production context '$CURRENT_CTX'."
  fi
fi
exit 0
